# Support Resources

Need help with **BoardPort — EDL Container**, USB connection issues, or device flashing workflows?
Check out the available support resources below.

---

## 1. Documentation

Before filing an issue, please review the documentation available in this repository:

- Main project documentation: [README.md](../README.md) / [README_RU.md](../README_RU.md)
- Architecture and internals: [ARCHITECTURE.md](../ARCHITECTURE.md) / [ARCHITECTURE_RU.md](../ARCHITECTURE_RU.md)
- Docker setup and command execution: [docker/README.md](../docker/README.md) / [docker/README_RU.md](../docker/README_RU.md)
- AI & Agent Guidelines: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) / [AGENTS_RU.md](../AGENTS_RU.md)

## 2. Issues & Bug Reports

- Check existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/boardport/edl-container/issues) to see if your problem or device has already been discussed.
- To report a bug or request device/loader support, use the provided [Issue Templates](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/).

## 3. Direct Contact

For inquiries, maintainer questions, or collaboration within the BoardPort ecosystem:
